messages:
deploy-bot: Promotion attempt for release v1.14.2 -> production failed at canary stage.

deploy-bot: Job: CI / promote-canary (run 582) failed at step integration-tests.
```
ERROR: seed_db: timeout waiting for migration lock
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/workspace/tests/integration/test_seed.py", line 42, in test_seed
    assert wait_for_migrations(timeout=30)
TimeoutError: migrations not available
```
alana: saw it right after the alert. Canary had 3 instances, 2 passed, 1 timed out.
alana: should we rerun the canary job or hold the promotion?
mike: stacktrace looks like a DB migration lock race during seed, we've been seeing this after the build-image bump yesterday.
mike: recent runs: run 579 passed, 580 flaky, 581 flaky, 582 failed.

sasha: +1 to image bump suspicion. The CI cache key for migrations uses the old image tag, so pods may hit stale migration state.
sasha: propose: invalidate migration cache and rerun only integration-tests for the canary.

kevin: caution: if we rerun and it passes, promotion will move the same artifact to prod. We should decide pin vs rollback. Is there any code change touching migrations in this release?
eva: release notes only mention perf and small API tweaks, no migration code. Customers on canary are internal only.

ops-bot: @channel manual hold requested by @alana. Promotion paused.

alana: ok let's not force promote. Plan: 1) clear CI remote cache for migration artifacts; 2) trigger integration-tests job for run 582 with new cache; 3) if it passes twice in a row, promote canary at 5% then monitor.

mike: command to clear cache (CI):
```
cictl cache purge --namespace=ci-deps --key=prod-migrations-cache
```
i'll run it now.

mike: triggered rerun: CI / integration-tests (rerun of 582) -> job 583

deploy-bot: Rerun started: https://ci.redwood.example/runs/583

mike: test logs look green so far, seed step completed without lock.

sasha: we should also fix cache key to include image digest so this doesn't happen again. I'll open a tiny PR to update .ci/cache.yaml.

kevin: not blocking, but we should pin artifact digest in promote command for audit.
kevin: promote command to run after two green runs:
```
deploy-bot promote --artifact=sha256:3a4f...c9e --canary=1 --canary-traffic=5
```
eva: please add a short note in release notes: "Canary hold and rerun due to transient DB seed flake; no data migrations in this release." Keeps support in the loop.

alana: agreed. I'll hold promotion until job 583 and 584 both pass, then run promote with digest pin. ETA ~ 25-30m.

ops-bot: Promotion remains paused. Will unpause on explicit promote command.

kevin: good call. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
